name: The drift config codec matches the firmware's drift mode layout
step: Check the drift config codec and Drift page
rationale:
The Drift page (Tuning -> Drift) saves by writing back what it read. The command ids
(gripora-firmware msp.c, MSP2_GRIPORA_DRIFT_CONFIG 0x5F42 / MSP2_GRIPORA_SET_DRIFT_CONFIG 0x5F43,
pg/drift.h), the four-byte layout (U8 gain %, U16 allow deg/s, U8 limit %), and the ranges and
defaults are pinned here: the firmware refuses the whole write if any value is out of range. A
longer reply must still decode the known four and the write must stay four; a shorter reply is
refused. Firmware without drift mode answers the command as unsupported: that must load the page
with its fields greyed out and write nothing, while a timeout stays a failed read. The harness
also checks that the page builds every field, refuses saves while armed, does not reboot and
follows the current PID profile, that it sits in the Steering group of the Tuning menu with an
icon that exists, and that DRIFT (mode id 68) is on the Modes page and in the setup wizard's
modes step.
